info.name: digiKam Face Sync
info.summary: Connects digiKam face rectangles with Recognize
info.description:
Adds authenticated APIs for importing digiKam face rectangles and reading named Recognize faces. Face descriptors are generated locally with the model installed by Recognize.
Also reports a cheap fingerprint of your named faces, so Face Sync can tell whether anything changed without reading the whole library, and whether Recognize is busy so it can wait its turn.
info.author: Keith Vassallo
